title: Chapter 270 Zerg Air Mobile Force
content:
Chapter 270 Zerg Air Mobile Force

The three important figures of the younger generation of the Bear Clan, Wolf Clan and Eagle Clan represent the faces of the three powerful clans, and their abilities are quite good.

Xiong San, Lang Lin and Ying Wen discussed with Wu Qing something about the human race outside the world. All three people's opinions were unique. Wu Qing also explained the Zerg race's plan, making it easy for all three to achieve this goal. The main purpose of coming to see Wu Qing this time.

Wu Qing said that the Zerg will take the initiative to attack the Tianwai Human Race in the near future, and try to attract the Tianwai Human Race to invest more troops here for a decisive battle.

The total strength of the Tianwai Human Race is definitely limited. If more troops are invested in the Zerg side, the troops in other directions will decrease accordingly.

Whether they can seize this opportunity and fight a beautiful counterattack depends on the abilities of the three powerful clans.

"Those human armies of the Tianwai Human Race are indeed powerful! If the strength of those human armies is reduced, I would dare to lead troops to attack the main cities of the Tianwai Human Race!"

Xiong San patted his strong chest and said.

"Do you, the Bear Clan, still need to fight the armies of those affiliated races of the Tianwai Human Clan?"

Yingwen said with some disdain.

"Hey, Yingwen, you dare to use the elites of your tribe to compete with the ordinary army of the human race?"

"As long as the Zerg tribe attracts enough human troops from outside the world, I, the bear tribe, will dare to fight back with all our strength!"

"I hope you Eagle Clan won't play tricks when the time comes!"

Xiong San leaned closer to Yingwen. His body felt very oppressive to Yingwen.

"How to fight back is not up to the three of us. We should bring the lord's ideas back to the clan and let the clan decide!"

Lang Lin interrupted the conversation between Xiong San and Ying Wen with a cold voice.

After getting along for a period of time, everyone found that Wu Qing had no airs and seemed very easy-going.

Especially Yingwen, he felt that Wu Qing at this time and Wu Qing just now were completely different from the same person.

Facing the easy-going Wu Qing, Ying Wen narrowed his eyes and blurted out: "Lord, the Zerg can easily defeat the outer human race, can you let us see the amazing lineup of the Zerg army?"

Although Xiong San and Lang Lin felt that what Ying Wen said was a bit inappropriate, they actually wanted to see the lineup of the Zerg main battle force.

Observers from the three tribes have reported very detailed intelligence, but the description of the intelligence is definitely different from what they saw with their own eyes.

They think their identity is sufficient, but in Wu Qing's case, this identity is useless.

"If you want to watch the Zerg army fight, don't go back yet. The Zerg army will go out in the next two days. You are welcome to follow the army and observe!"

Wu Qing smiled and said.

It was impossible for him to pull out the Zerg army just to put on a show for these people. The Yingwen of the Ying Clan was indeed a little ignorant. I don’t know whether it was intentional or just his nature. It might be both.

These three people are not low-status and capable. They will definitely be important figures among the three tribes in the future.

But Wu Qing didn't like the personalities of the three of them, so he didn't plan to talk to them any more.

Moreover, the future is too long, and they simply cannot keep up with the speed of development of the Zerg.

"Okay! When the Zerg army sets off, I will definitely come to watch the battle!"

Xiong San readily agreed to come and watch the battle, while Yingwen and Lang Lin remained silent.

Gong Yi was very good at dealing with people and could sense Wu Qing's thoughts, so he took the initiative to bring the visit to the final topic.

In fact, the three tribes sent a visiting gift, and the Zerg tribe returned a gift in return.

After exchanging gifts, the three tribes did not stay long and said goodbye and returned to the main city.

Subsequently, more and more people from various forces came to visit, and Gong Yi was the first to come over, just to deal with this situation.

Gong Yi introduced various visiting forces to Wu Qing and suggested to Wu Qing that those forces need to receive them personally, while those forces only need to send people to receive them.

Wu Qing was not afraid that the goblins would trick him, so he followed Gong Yi's suggestion.

After a day of reception, Wu Qing had a preliminary understanding of many forces.

Those who came today are all forces that are optimistic about the prospects of the Zerg. They want to establish a good relationship with the Zerg, the future big race, in advance.

The stronger the force, the faster they move and the faster they travel, so later on, Wu Qing rarely showed up in person.

In the next few days, many forces will come over one after another. These forces are not worthy of Wu Qing's personal reception, so Wu Qing will leave them to the Queen of Worms to receive them.

After Gong Yi arrived, he had no intention of leaving immediately. In addition to helping the Zerg sort out the relationship with all parties, he also had to wait for the city-building team from the Goblin Chamber of Commerce to arrive.

Wu Qing asked the Zerg worker bees to clear a safe area for the goblins to settle down.

At this time, the 200,000-strong army of the Niu tribe finally arrived, followed by several armies of other races.

These armies are all the armies of races that intend to help the Zerg fight. Wu Qing will certainly not treat them badly and let the Zerg Queen settle down properly.

Wu Qing is going to give some benefits to these races that have good intentions towards the Zerg for whatever reason. The spoils harvested on the battlefield can be given priority to them and sold at a low price.

Niu Zhong also found several items of great significance to the Niu Clan from the trophies as he wished, and Wu Qing gave them all to the Niu Clan.

In addition, some trophies needed by the cattle tribe will also be sold to them at the lowest price.

The sixty-sixth city will soon be cleaned up through the continuous cleaning of the Zerg worker bees, and then it will be handed over to the city construction team of the Goblin Chamber of Commerce for reconstruction.

The Queen will discuss the specific reconstruction plan with the city construction experts of the Goblin Clan.

…

After a day of action, tens of millions of Zerg puppies, under the guidance of the Zerg host, eliminated a large number of goblins.

As long as the goblins are discovered, they will not be able to escape from the pursuit of the Zerg puppies.

The Zerg host also drew a detailed map of a large area centered on the 66th City. The Zerg puppies and the Zerg host will plan a safe place to stay at night according to this detailed map before dark.

The Zerg puppies have experienced several battles with the star-level soldiers of the alien human race. They are all small-scale armies. The nearby Zerg puppies gathered and launched a siege with superior forces. After some losses, they all successfully wiped out the enemy.

The Zerg host also found several places where the alien human army gathered. The size of the alien human army in these gathering places is not small. It is difficult to rely on Zerg puppies to besiege them, but sending the main Zerg combat troops to fight is a waste of time and combat power.

Wu Qing thought about it and hatched 200,000 one-star Zerg dragons on the basis of the original 300,000 Zerg dragons.

More than 500,000 star Zerg dragons, including a large number of high-star Zerg dragons, are a mobile and powerful flying force led by 2,000 five-star Zerg dragons. They are very suitable for cooperating with Zerg puppies to quickly clear enemies of small scale.

Wu Qing plans to form an efficient and flexible air mobile force with more than 500,000 Zerg dragons as the main force, and Zerg hosts, Zerg queens, Zerg explosive mosquitoes and other Zerg flying arms as auxiliary.

The Zerg air mobile force is mainly responsible for eliminating those alien human armies that are difficult for Zerg puppies to deal with and it is too wasteful to send the main Zerg army.

The situation that the Zerg Puppies detected in the Demon Clan territory is similar. There are many enemies that the Zerg Puppies cannot attack alone, and sending out the Zerg main combat forces is too time-consuming and wasteful.

At this time, the mobile and powerful Zerg air mobile forces are the best choice to cooperate with the Zerg Puppies in combat.

Therefore, the demand for Zerg air mobile forces is very large.

The Zerg air mobile forces, which are mainly composed of more than 500,000 Zerg flying dragons, can only be responsible for combat missions on the public battlefield of the Southern Theater. This force may still be insufficient, and the force will continue to be increased according to the situation.

In the battlefield in the direction of the Demon Clan, Wu Qing also needs to form another Zerg air mobile force.

Now the battlefield where the Zerg participates has greatly improved the number and strength of the enemy, and the resources obtained by the system from the battlefield are much more than before.

In addition, Wu Qing's large-scale layout in this world has begun to yield results, and the system's gas resources have more stable sources.

The performance of the Zerg in the public battlefield of the Southern Theater, combined with the propaganda of the Silkworm Knight, the Zerg now has a little reputation in this world.

In addition to the gas resources obtained by the Zerg army from the battlefield, there will be a large amount of gas resources from other sources every day, which is enough for Wu Qing to form a large number of Zerg main combat forces.

Now the system resources are not lacking, but Wu Qing is going to temporarily slow down the formation of the Zerg air mobile forces in the direction of the demons and the Zerg ground main combat forces, waiting for the Zerg puppies and Zerg hosts to find out the details of the demon territory, and then form these forces according to the actual needs based on the reaction and response of the demons.

...

Early the next morning.

The newly formed Zerg air mobile force flew to an alien army not far from the 66th city based on the intelligence found yesterday.

The Zerg air mobile force, each branch of the army has a very fast flight speed, and can fly in a straight line from the air, so it arrived at the target location in a very short time.

The target is a gathering place where 600,000 or 700,000 star-level soldiers of the affiliated races of the aliens gather. On the periphery of this gathering place, there are already millions of Zerg puppies lurking.

If the Zerg puppies attacked the gathering place of nearly 700,000 well-trained and well-equipped alien army alone, even if the millions of Zerg puppies lurking around fought to the death, they might not be able to completely wipe out the alien army.

Now with the participation of the Zerg air mobile force, the result is completely different.

Under the unified command of the Queen, the Zerg air mobile force was still a certain distance away from the target, and the Zerg puppies launched an attack on the target.

The black mass of Zerg puppies rushed towards the gathering place of the alien army, and the alien army, which had been on alert, immediately fought back.
